title: Summit Draw Disbursement Limits and Methods
content:
Disbursement figures for draws on the Cedarline Summit Proprietary Reverse Mortgage. Amounts are in US dollars.

| Plan | Smallest draw disbursed | Largest draw by verified phone request | Disbursed within | Methods | Smallest draw sent by wire | Draw returned by the receiving bank |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Fixed Lump Sum | USD 0.00 (no line) | USD 0.00 (no line) | 5 business days | none | USD 10000.00 | not applicable |
| Summit Flex Fixed | USD 1000.00 | USD 25000.00 | 5 business days | ACH, wire | USD 10000.00 | reissued to corrected instructions |
| Summit Select Line | USD 500.00 | USD 25000.00 | 5 business days | ACH, wire, check | USD 10000.00 | reissued to corrected instructions |
| Summit Condo Line | USD 500.00 | USD 25000.00 | 5 business days | ACH, wire, check | USD 10000.00 | reissued to corrected instructions |
| Summit Second Lien | USD 0.00 (no line) | USD 0.00 (no line) | 5 business days | none | USD 10000.00 | not applicable |
| Summit Estate Line | USD 2500.00 | USD 50000.00 | 5 business days | ACH, wire | USD 10000.00 | reissued to corrected instructions |

## Notes

- A complete draw request is disbursed within 5 business days under every plan.
- A check is a disbursement method only under the Summit Select Line and the Summit Condo Line; the Summit Flex Fixed and the Summit Estate Line disburse by ACH or wire.
- The wire threshold is USD 10000.00 under every plan: a draw of USD 10000.00 or more may go by wire.
- The Summit Fixed Lump Sum and the Summit Second Lien have no line, so their draw limits stand at USD 0.00, they list no method and a returned draw does not arise.

|---|---|---|
| USD 24750.00 | within | within |
| USD 25000.00 | within (equal to the limit) | within |
